Why: the discriminator's 60-dim single-tick feature set (joint pos/vel, base angular vel, projected gravity, foot pos RELATIVE TO THE BODY) cannot distinguish a gait that translates from one that doesn't -- in the body frame both look identical unless slip is present, so style reward alone has zero incentive to convert leg motion into displacement.
